status: PILOT, SINGLE EVENT, OFFICIAL SAR-DERIVED LABEL; NOT FIELD VALIDATED
target: unchanged Phase 9 target_union_minus_baseline; no relabeling or target re-rasterization

validation.outer: reconstructed using the exact deterministic Phase 9 GroupKFold algorithm; 5 folds; full block ID held out
validation.phase9_split_audit: Per-fold held-out cell counts and true prevalences match docs/PHASE9_METRICS.json. Its serialized test_block_ids are incorrectly identical across all five folds (bookkeeping defect); Phase 9B does not trust those IDs, and instead reconstructs the assignments from source code and verifies disjoint complete block partitioning.
validation.buffer: same 1 neighboring 3 km block ring removed from training; min block gap 3km
validation.population_nodata: excluded as a mask; never used as a feature
validation.sampling: all positive training cells plus 3:1 block-stratified negatives; only on training indices; evaluation uses all eligible test cells at their true prevalence
validation.imputation_scaling: per estimator fit on its sampled training rows only
validation.calibration: Platt calibration fit on inner spatial-block OOF predictions only; cross-fitted calibration predictions choose F1 threshold and conformal residual quantile within outer training blocks
validation.inner_split: Two geographically contiguous block-row halves; choose the cut that best balances cells while retaining both classes after the same one-block buffer. The two inner validation halves partition each outer training set.

dense_urban_exclusion.cutoff: built_up_fraction > 0.50 excluded from both training and evaluation

interpretation.plain_language: Adding land cover increased mean PR-AUC; adding road/building/population proxies increased it further. Most full-feature skill remains after dense-urban exclusion.
interpretation.caution: Ablation differences are descriptive paired spatial-CV results, not causal attribution; built-up, roads and population can encode exposure or label-mapping bias.

random_forest.search_strategy: 30 fixed-seed random configurations per outer fold; 2 inner buffered GroupKFold folds; ranking objective average precision on full-prevalence inner validation blocks

xgboost.search_strategy: 30 fixed-seed random configurations per outer fold; 2 inner buffered GroupKFold folds; ranking objective average precision on full-prevalence inner validation blocks

lightgbm.search_strategy: 30 fixed-seed random configurations per outer fold; 2 inner buffered GroupKFold folds; ranking objective average precision on full-prevalence inner validation blocks

importance.method: Held-out outer-fold permutation, average precision decrease, up to 3,000 true-prevalence cells per fold, one permutation per feature per fold.
importance.physical_review: Check whether terrain/hydrology features rank ahead of urban, road and population proxies; prominence of exposure/access variables may reflect mapping/source bias, not flood physics.

physical_sanity_result.flag: Exposure/access proxy is among the strongest ten features; treat apparent predictive skill cautiously.

moran.interpretation: descriptive OOF residual spatial autocorrelation; no inferential p-value computed

error_classes.0: correct at pooled median outer threshold

limitations: Single 2015 event target; no out-of-event performance claim.
Target is official SAR-derived extent, not field-validated and does not represent the Dec 1–8 peak.
Population-NoData cells are excluded as a mask; the model's evaluation denominator is therefore smaller than Phase 9.
New drainage and water distance features inherit DSM, OSM incompleteness, D8 sinks and WorldCover 2021 source limitations.
Nested tuning/calibration and maps are a pilot; full-data maps are apparent, not independent validation.

chosen_model.name: simple_average_tuned_tree_ensemble
chosen_model.selection: highest mean outer-fold PR-AUC; if the simple ensemble is within one SD of the best, choose the ensemble for stability; no out-of-event evidence supports a deployment claim

decision_metrics.calibration_note: Platt calibration and F1 threshold are learned only from inner spatial-block OOF predictions in each outer training set; reported outer metrics use held-out blocks.
decision_metrics.gain_curve_definition: precision, recall and gain over prevalence in the top-ranked fraction of the held-out or pooled OOF cells

uncertainty.method: 90% split-conformalized absolute-error band using cross-fitted Platt probabilities from inner buffered training blocks; outer test blocks assess empirical coverage.
uncertainty.caveat: Spatial autocorrelation weakens exchangeability assumptions. The band is for the binary label probability response, not water-depth uncertainty.

out_of_event.reason: Only accepted A/B/C event layers are the two November 2015 dates used in the Phase 9 target; baseline-water dates are not event holdouts.
out_of_event.evaluation: not run; no independent accepted event/date label exists
